root_owner_goal: Historically verified multi-system astrology plus independently evaluated behavior model; remains OPEN

historical_sources.author: William Lilly
historical_sources.read_mode: Original first-print images read and source-specific registrations preserved; no Greek manuscript collation.
historical_sources.scope: Natal planet essential dignities and debilities at own degrees, possible reciprocal reception only, and planetary house and direct/retrograde subcomponents

historical_sources.author: Ptolemy (as translated by F. E. Robbins)
historical_sources.edition: 1940 Loeb printed Greek-English alternative term witnesses
historical_sources.scope: Ptolemaic and Egyptian term tables treated as historically independent variants, not proof of stronger personal fit

combination: Researcher-composed, source-component-point additive partial comparison. 72 combinations: independent printed terms (3) × intrinsic/reception policies (4) × Regiomontanus/Placidus house geometry (2) × finite-value station abstention windows (3). Historically source points do NOT establish a complete unique planet governor.
scoring_interval: Exact component points only where supported; near-station unknown direct/retrograde is bounded [-5,+4]. A planet wins only when its lower possible score exceeds every other body's upper possible score under that specific method; near-horizon sect unknown always abstains. Independent cross-method consensus only if all 72 methods select the SAME strict unique body.
source_scope_limits: Original Lilly p112 reception explicitly requires planets actually to signify the question/matter, not merely mutual zodiac positions. These are labeled POTENTIAL only; most reception categories unmodeled.

Original p115 swift/slow, orientation to Sun, solar beams, partile benefic and malefic aspects, nodes, named fixed stars and besiegement omitted; no bounds on all missing historic components. Partial score winner is not a final ruler.
Original CVII earlier S1/S2/S3/SX/S4/S5 source-stage eligibility and final dignity-at-Mercury/Moon places are not replaced by natal-body own degree strength score.
Original Ptolemy III.13 fifth phase/aspect, sect/contrary testimony and final governor not determined.
Historical Regiomontanus vs cached Placidus is a sensitivity, not a claim that Lilly used both.
Finite station windows 0.01/0.02/0.05 degrees/day are researcher uncertainty, not ancient speed/orb definitions.
One fixed research-place and quarter-hour 1926–2026 3.5m grid does not cover all continuous natal moments or geographical locations.
Source-conditioned candidate astronomical similarity does not independently validate human personality or prove unique natal first place.
